deadline.value: The faculty states no application deadline; applications for acceptance are handled outside the monthly committee meeting.
deadline.quote: The applications for acceptance are handled separately by the Doctoral Committee and are not part of the monthly Doctoral Committee meeting.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: A doctoral supervision agreement with your supervisor must be finalised, and the application for acceptance follows.
supervisor.quote: Once your thesis project supervision is confirmed, the next step is to finalize a doctoral supervision agreement with your supervisor.

funding.value: The faculty page states no funding rule.

entry_route.value: A qualifying degree is required: a German master's programme, or a German study programme of at least four years.
entry_route.quote: a) a master's program at a German university, | b) a study program at a German university or a college of education with a minimum study duration of four years

notes: Faculty-wide rules for the Faculty of Engineering. Individual departments (computer science, mechanical, materials, biomedical engineering, chemical engineering) were not checked separately, so no records were saved for them.
